name: Chamroeun Hongleng
headline: I build and ship software — web systems, decision engines, bilingual education and agritech tools — in TypeScript and Python, and fine-tune Khmer speech models when a product needs one, with honest metrics and an evidence label on every claim.
identity: Dual-degree student — Computer Science at Fort Hays State and IT Management at AUPP — and national runner-up in mathematics, 2025. Learning to work as an AI-native developer, and building at CHNAI LAB, a six-member student studio in Phnom Penh, where I work most closely with one teammate.
intro: I build software end to end: web systems, auditable decision tools for smallholder agriculture, and bilingual education tooling — and I add the applied-ML layer when a product needs one, like Khmer speech recognition where public data is scarce. The work stays grounded in field research with real farmers and in the business questions these systems ship into.
availability: Actively looking for a software engineering internship — full-stack, backend, or data and ML tooling — remote or Phnom Penh.

proofPoints.text: Built a complete Khmer speech-recognition fine-tuning pipeline on Whisper-small — data preparation, training, evaluation, export, and an installable CLI, all public, with the fine-tuned weights on Hugging Face. Best checkpoint: 17.48% character error rate on its held-out split (self-reported).
Designed a deterministic farm-lot decision engine with 62 unit tests, CI, and bilingual Khmer/English audit reports — running on synthetic data by design.
Awarded a 100% bachelor's-degree scholarship to the American University of Phnom Penh as second-place laureate in mathematics, on a rector-signed certificate dated 30 April 2025.

Grade A in Cambodia's national Bac II examination in 2025, carrying a 100% four-year bachelor's scholarship awarded by the Ministry of Justice for study at the Royal University of Phnom Penh — one of twenty recipients named on the ministry's official list for the 2025–2026 academic year.
Top 2 placement, Turing Hackathon Cycle 10 (Market Access for Farmers track), with the Chomkar OrderLoop concept.

aiWorkingStyle: I work AI-natively: AI tools (primarily Claude) support my research, drafting, and implementation, while decisions, evidence labels, and anything that ships stay under human review — mine.
